en.html:
There had been a regrettable incident, but time proceeded as usual. Lunch break arrived. My classmates began moving in little groups to eat.

I had brought no packed lunch. Cafeteria or school shop: one of those would be necessary.

Which today...?

悲しむべき事件はあったが、常と同じく時間は進み、
昼休みとなった。
　級友達が三々五々、昼食をとるため動き始める。

　俺は弁当を持ってきていないので、食堂へ向かうか、
売店で買うかしなければならない。

　今日はどうするか……。

en.html:
Turning at the call, I found a female student standing in a strangely uncertain manner. Everybody in school knew her: daughter of a great financial family, daughter of the board chairman, winner of the cultural festival's beauty contest.

For some reason, she held two lunch boxes.

ja.html:
呼ばれて振り返ると、一人の女子学生が奇妙に所在
なげな様子で佇んでいた。
　学内では知らぬ者のいない、財閥令嬢にして理事長
の娘、文化祭のミス・コンテスト優勝者である。

　その手には何故か、弁当箱を二つ抱えていた。

en.html:
Kageaki"Something I can do?"
ｅｔｃ／ヒロインＥ"Lunch... still to come?"
Kageaki"Yes."
ｅｔｃ／ヒロインＥ"You do not bring a packed lunch, right? Minato?"
Kageaki"Correct. Cafeteria or school shop."
ｅｔｃ／ヒロインＥ"I-I see. Good..."
Kageaki"Pardon?"
ｅｔｃ／ヒロインＥ"Ahem."
ｅｔｃ／ヒロインＥ"W-well... I-if you like, would you eat this?"
Kageaki"...? That lunch?"
ｅｔｃ／ヒロインＥ"Y-yes... Ah, no! Not like that!"
Kageaki"Not like what?"
ｅｔｃ／ヒロインＥ"This was actually made for a friend in my club! B-but she is absent today!"
ｅｔｃ／ヒロインＥ"Throwing it away would be wasteful... Then you happened to be here, so I thought, if you liked, perhaps you could eat it."
ｅｔｃ／ヒロインＥ"That is all!"
Kageaki"I see. Circumstances understood."
ｅｔｃ／ヒロインＥ"...You will eat it?"
Kageaki"With gratitude."
ｅｔｃ／ヒロインＥ"I-I see. Then... here."
ｅｔｃ／ヒロインＥ"Ah, but do not misunderstand! It was not made for you!"
Kageaki"...? Yes. Naturally."
ｅｔｃ／ヒロインＥ"R-really! It really... was not..."
Kageaki"Understood."

en.html:
For some reason, after repeatedly impressing that upon me, she left. Apparently she very much did not want me to think she had made it for me.

Did she dislike me?
Even so, if she chose me to receive it because I had no lunch, I could only call her a person of excellent character.

Her popularity in school was understandable.

Opening the box, I found a message card. Only a few words.

“I like you.”

en.html:
I see.
Everything had become clear.

Originally, this was meant for the person she liked. Naturally she had warned me again and again against misunderstanding.

With all matters properly understood, I did not make the mistake of supposing that card addressed to me. Only gratitude was required for her consideration in giving such an important lunch to somebody like me.

The contents were plainly homemade. Every dish a favorite of mine. Almost as though she had investigated my tastes and prepared it specially.

Naturally, mere coincidence.

I did not misunderstand.
Absolutely did not.

ja.html:
成程。
　俺は全てを理解した。

　これは本来、彼女の想い人へ贈られるはずだった物
なのだ。
　勘違いするなと何度も念を押されたのは当然である。

　万事諒解した俺は、その手紙が自分宛てであるなど
という勘違いを決してしなかった。
　大切な弁当を俺などにくれた彼女の心遣いに対して
感謝だけしておく。

　弁当の中身は、明らかに手作りであり、そして俺の
好物ばかりだった。
　まるで彼女が俺のために好みを調べて用意したかの
ようにも思える。

　勿論、単なる偶然だ。

　俺は勘違いしなかった。
　決してしなかった。
